main_road_of_crows:return_village.title: Who receives the road's account
main_road_of_crows:return_village.uncertainty: These traces do not establish every person's part in what happened.
main_road_of_crows:return_village.follow_through: Kael stays with the investigation. A report does not promise anyone else's participation.

options.commitment: Give Anwen the token privately and commit to protecting people who choose to speak.
options.cost: The wider village will not yet have the same account.

options.commitment: Put the recovered evidence before Greyfen and commit to protecting its witnesses.
options.cost: Public disclosure makes the account harder to contain and may expose its bearers.

options.commitment: Keep the original token, make protected copies, and remain responsible for the investigation.
options.cost: Keeping the original with Kael delays a wider public account.

main_bell_beneath_greyfen:crow_shrine_ch.title: What the shrine will hold
main_bell_beneath_greyfen:crow_shrine_ch.uncertainty: Quiet at the chapel would not prove that the debt has ended.

options.commitment: Clean the rite and record that its danger shifts toward the wood.
options.cost: Containment moves; the underlying account remains unsettled.

options.commitment: Open the shrine's memory while keeping the gathered names intact.
options.cost: Greyfen will hear the bell and the account can no longer stay quietly sealed.

options.commitment: Hold the seal for now and record its limits.
options.cost: This buys a temporary quiet. It does not settle what the shrine concealed.

main_teeth_in_rain:bog_core_choice.title: The limits of a recovered memory

facts.title: Oren's name on the chapel wall
facts.text: The erased chapel names include Oren. His recovered name can be spoken without treating a memory fragment as the whole person.

main_teeth_in_rain:bog_core_choice.uncertainty: The fragment cannot answer every question about the road or give consent for the child it remembers.

options.commitment: End the vessel by destroying the exposed memory core.
options.cost: The memory held in this vessel disperses; it cannot be kept here for further study.

options.commitment: Keep the exposed fragment for bounded study with Mira.
options.cost: Keeping a fragment creates a continuing duty to limit how it is used.

options.commitment: Settle the fragment beneath Oren's named grave.
options.cost: Its intimate memory will not become material for public study.

main_names_they_burned:names_choice.title: How the recovered names become known

facts.title: The reconstructed register
facts.text: The recovered pages restore the refugee names. Family addresses can be separated from the public account.

main_names_they_burned:names_choice.uncertainty: A correct record cannot promise how every household will respond to its publication.

options.commitment: Publish the recovered names and order while removing family addresses.
options.cost: Public challenge puts pressure on the people carrying the account, even with addresses protected.

options.commitment: Keep separate protected copies and warn affected households before the assembly.
options.cost: The public order remains unchallenged during the delay.

main_ash_at_the_mill:mill_choice.title: Food, work, and the mill's account

facts.title: Workers reached the south yard
facts.text: The rescued workers reached clean air and can keep their own wage accounts.
facts.source: Workers brought out through the escape channel

facts.title: Wage records above the waterline
facts.text: The wage chest has been moved out of the channel's reach. Household shares remain documented.

main_ash_at_the_mill:mill_choice.uncertainty: A decision about the mill's operation does not establish whether its workers or loose records were rescued.
main_ash_at_the_mill:mill_choice.follow_through: Worker rescue and household deliveries are recorded separately from this operating decision.

options.commitment: Close the tainted channels, preserve the ledger, and divide relief reserves.
options.cost: Workers lose shifts while the village relies on carried reserve grain.

options.commitment: Keep supervised milling after making a signed copy of the contaminated working sheet.
options.cost: Contamination risk remains while separate clean channels are prepared.

options.commitment: Post copied accounts and begin clean repairs with restitution for affected households.
options.cost: Clean materials and labor must go into repair before the promise can be sustained.

main_soldier_without_banner:senn_choice.title: Senn's accountability

facts.title: The abandoned soldiers' record
facts.text: The hidden muster records the soldiers Senn left behind. Their refusal is distinct from his account.

main_soldier_without_banner:senn_choice.uncertainty: An admission establishes a person's account; it does not excuse the road killings or supply another person's consent.

options.commitment: Accept Senn's surrender under custody and his freely offered testimony.
options.cost: Custody requires protection and continuing accountability; surrender is not permission for another attack.

options.commitment: Keep the written account, disarm the camp, and permit Senn to leave.
options.cost: Senn leaves without a living oath to appear. His written account remains.

options.commitment: Execute Senn for the road killings while retaining the documented account.
options.cost: His future testimony ends with his life.

options.commitment: Present yourself as the bearer of testimony from the old road.
options.follow_through: Continue into the courtyard and follow the written order.

main_blood_under_stone:ledger_choice.title: Keeping a credible command record

facts.title: The command beside the register
facts.text: The command ledger can be compared with the refugee register. A credible copy can survive a decision about the original.

main_blood_under_stone:ledger_choice.uncertainty: Possessing the command proves what was written. It cannot make its authors or heirs willing witnesses.

options.commitment: Take the original fragment openly and keep a copy of its command.
options.cost: Removing the fragment openly draws the guards' suspicion.

options.commitment: Conceal the fragment while keeping a credible copy of the command.
options.cost: The original leaves the archive without a public account of its removal.

options.commitment: Keep a signed copy and leave the original available in the record hall.
options.cost: Kael carries the copy; the original remains under the castle's control.

main_blood_under_stone:last_witness_hook.title: Edric's answer to the renewal
main_blood_under_stone:last_witness_hook.uncertainty: A public hearing still has to reckon with the account. Protecting a hearing does not protect a title from accountability.

options.commitment: Protect Edric's hearing while accepting his voluntary agreement to testify and release grain without signatures.
options.cost: His title and accounts remain subject to the public hearing.

options.commitment: Expose the ledger and challenge Edric's power to require household signatures.
options.cost: Edric refuses a personal oath. The proof must stand without pretending he agrees.

options.commitment: Compel Edric's admission and preserve it as evidence of concealment.
options.cost: Words obtained under pressure do not count as a freely given responsibility.

main_last_witness:halvern_choice.title: A refusal with limits

facts.title: A hearing earned
facts.text: Halvern's guard has yielded. An opening for his account does not make the bound memory complete.

main_last_witness:halvern_choice.uncertainty: Halvern's fragment holds a bounded refusal. It cannot answer every question about what followed.

options.commitment: Preserve Halvern's refusal as testimony without demanding another oath.
options.cost: The exhausted fragment remains bound; its presence does not restore all its memory.

options.commitment: Record the refusal, then release the exhausted memory.
options.cost: The copy preserves the refusal, not everything the departing fragment held.

options.commitment: Keep the copied order and end the remaining grave binding.
options.cost: The remaining fragment ends. Its unrecorded memories cannot be retained in the copy.

main_crowns_without_mercy:confession_cho.title: What the assembly asks of people
main_crowns_without_mercy:confession_cho.uncertainty: Attendance, food, and a completed account cannot establish a household's consent.
main_crowns_without_mercy:confession_cho.follow_through: The ration condition ends. Participation in the hearing remains separate from receiving help.

options.commitment: Release the grain and invite only those who choose to give their account.
options.cost: Refusals must be accepted; the hearing cannot demand a voice in exchange for supper.

options.commitment: Break the ration condition and read the copied account in Kael's own name.
options.cost: Kael accepts responsibility for preserving and carrying what he reads.

options.commitment: Break the ration condition and make Edric answer from the ledger.
options.cost: His compelled answer remains evidence, not a willing oath.

final_covenant.title: The intention Kael will carry out
final_covenant.uncertainty: The living still have work to do. Choosing an intention does not complete its enactment or settle every grievance.

options.commitment: Choose Witness: make the account public and accept the work of preserving it.
options.cost: Restitution and an open account demand continuing work; choosing this cannot promise who will help.
options.follow_through: Lay the ledger, speak the recovered names, and speak of Kael's retreat at the marked places.

options.commitment: Choose Mercy: release the Hart while protecting the public record and private family memories.
options.cost: The living must preserve the record after releasing its bound witness.
options.follow_through: Return the family tokens, keep the public record, and untie the witness at the marked places.

options.commitment: Choose Duty: Kael freely accepts the unresolved binding in his own name.
options.cost: Kael gives up freedom and rest. His choice cannot pledge a child or another keeper.
options.follow_through: Set down the badge, name the limits of the promise, and take the willing burden.

options.commitment: Choose Ash: confront the Hart to end the binding while preserving the human record.
options.cost: Ending the vessel gives up the memories only it holds; the land bears their dispersal.
options.follow_through: Face the Hart in the glade. The confrontation must be completed before the outcome is settled.

side_widows_bell:widow_choice.title: Elna's account and participation
side_widows_bell:widow_choice.uncertainty: Knowing why the bell rang cannot decide whether Elna wants her grief made public.

side_iron_remembers:tor_choice.title: The forge's responsibility
side_iron_remembers:tor_choice.uncertainty: Settling the marked stock does not decide whether Tor gives a public oath.

side_bitter_roots:mira_choice.title: A treatment people can choose
side_bitter_roots:mira_choice.uncertainty: A useful treatment does not establish a family's informed agreement to its source.

side_black_dog:dog_choice.title: Protection at the fold
side_black_dog:dog_choice.uncertainty: Calling a fragment protective does not make its danger to the fold disappear.

side_empty_grave:walker_choice.title: A repeated watch
side_empty_grave:walker_choice.uncertainty: A repeated memory cannot supply everything the living man once knew.

side_soldiers_debt:debt_choice.title: The soldiers' refusal
side_soldiers_debt:debt_choice.uncertainty: Carrying a signed refusal does not authorize exposing a protected identity.

side_millers_measure:ash_choice.title: Where the true measure can help
side_millers_measure:ash_choice.uncertainty: Placing the account in useful hands does not complete every repair or delivery.

side_rooks_map:map_choice.title: A useful road and a personal account
side_rooks_map:map_choice.uncertainty: Keeping a route useful does not decide whether Rook speaks publicly.
